recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a smiling man leaning against a weathered wooden post in a sun-drenched forest, featuring bold, centered typography that interacts with the subject through transparency and layering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with vertical wooden post acting as a secondary anchor
Warm golden-hour lens flare intersecting the subject and the primary text
High-contrast dark typography against a bright, hazy background
coreInvariants: Two-tier typographic hierarchy with extreme weight contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man in medium shot, waist-up, positioned slightly right of center, leaning left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical wooden beam on the left provides a structural frame for the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the light flare down to the hands, then moves across the horizontal text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced between the dense forest background and the open space around the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm golden-yellow and earthy greens (background and lighting)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep forest green or charcoal (primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background creating a hazy, backlit effect; high saturation in the warm tones.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses heavy, blocky strokes with square terminals
Secondary text uses ultra-thin, wide-tracked strokes
Uniform stroke width within each tier

composition.overlap: layered over the subject with slight transparency

treatment.fill: solid dark green with subtle texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast (Black vs. Light) within the same sans-serif family.

preserve: Heavy weight for the display name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the primary name.
Offers the clean, airy, extended look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium portrait of a man with a beard and short hair, smiling, wearing a dark button-down shirt over a white t-shirt. He is leaning against a rustic wooden beam in a forest. The scene is lit by warm, golden-hour sunlight with a prominent lens flare coming from the upper left. The background is a soft-focus forest with autumn leaves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text across the middle. The top line should be a heavy, bold geometric sans-serif in dark forest green. The bottom line should be a thin, wide-spaced sans-serif in white. Ensure the text has a slight transparency to let the background light show through.

verificationChecks: Is the lens flare visible across the subject and text?
Is the weight contrast between the two lines of text extreme?
Is the color palette warm and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the dark green text
Amount of tracking in the subtitle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and environment

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the subject's clothing.
Check that the wooden post provides a strong vertical element.
Verify the golden-hour haze is consistent across the image.
Confirm the tracking on the subtitle is wide enough to span the width of the primary text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic outdoor portrait with high-contrast, two-tier sans-serif typography and a warm, atmospheric light flare overlay.
